The sources only mention that he was the supervisor on duty when the chiller failed and that he recalled the temperature alarm sounding on 18 June 2026 [1]. There is no information about when the chiller was repaired [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026
